messages:
Nadia P: Quick FYI, v4.0-int4 on staged canary (3% traffic) is showing a reproducible uplift in token-loss on the short-answer slice.
Theo L: how big is the uplift? sample size?
Nadia P: sample=3,200 queries over last 2.5h. token-loss +3.1% vs v3.9 baseline, exact-match down -0.6% on short-answer. long-doc slice unchanged and slightly better.
Priya S: short-answer = user_chat where reply_len < 30 tokens? that's sensitive for UX.
Nadia P: yep: slice filter: `slice == short_answer && route == chat` . bootstrap CI for exact-match on that slice: [-1.1%, -0.2%] so small but consistent.
Marco T: do we hit any of the auto-fallback rules? what thresholds are configured now?
Nadia P: current canary rules (excerpt):
```
canary_auto_fallback:
  exact_match_drop_pct: 0.5
  token_loss_increase_pct: 2.0
  latency_p95_increase_ms: 20
  min_sample: 1000
  cooldown_minutes: 30
```
qa-bot: Regression detector: id=reg_short_ans_v4_int4 severity=medium alerted=eng-ml-oncall
Theo L: token-loss +3.1% > 2.0% threshold -> should trigger fallback, but this is slice-specific. prefer to avoid full rollback unless other slices affected.
Priya S: Agreed. Suggest targeted mitigation: narrow traffic to the slice only and run a focused A/B for 45m, plus run a 25k synthetic short-answer eval.
Marco T: Also propose a "soft-lease" routing option: keep stable users on baseline for 45m TTL to reduce churn impact. Implementation: route key = user_id_recent && TTL<45m -> pin to v3.9.
Nadia P: ops: can you reduce canary traffic to 1.5% and enable lease pin for 45m?
ops-bot: Scaling canary down to 1.5% now. Lease pin policy queued for deployment to routing rules.
deploy-bot: Canary snapshot created: canary/6211112222/v4.0-int4 @ us-east1
Priya S: I'll kick off the synthetic eval job (25k short queries) and share job id.
qa-bot: Synthetic eval queued: job id=2026-44-shortans-synth ETA ~22m.
Theo L: If targeted A/B still shows the same delta, next step is micro-quant tuning (per-layer qscale) and retrain calibration pass. Could also try int4 NF4 vs sim8 variant.
Nadia P: good. Also adding a canary report change: include top-20 failing prompts and a diff-view against baseline (token-level). Helps PMs triage.
Marco T: note: update auto-fallback to be slice-aware: only fallback that slice's traffic back to baseline instead of whole model. Config proposal:
```
slice_auto_fallback: true
slice_fallback_rules:
  - metric: token_loss
    thresh_pct: 2.0
    action: fallback_slice
```
Theo L: +1 on slice fallback. For metrics, gate with min_sample=2000 for slice-level auto-fallback to avoid noisy decisions.
Nadia P: action items:
- ops: drop canary -> 1.5% and enable lease pin 45m
- priya/qa: run 25k synthetic short-answer eval and targeted A/B for 45m (short_answer & chat)
- eng-ml: add failing-prompts diff to canary report
- infra: implement slice-level fallback and min_sample 2000 guard
- if token-loss > 2% on short_answer OR exact-match drop > 0.5% -> fallback that slice to v3.9
ops-bot: Canary throttled to 1.5%.
qa-bot: job started: 2026-44-shortans-synth, will post results.
Nadia P: thanks all. Will monitor and post A/B results here. :mag: dashboard: https://redwood.app/d/canaries/6211112222
